name: Super Date
source:
Ian Edgard Mortell, a 30-year-old male immortal attends the "Super Date," a speed dating event full of super-powered people like himself.

Can Ian overcome his nihilism and find the one of his life?

[Translated from [url=https://leothelionel.itch.io/thehumanheart]Itch.io[/url]]
